sources.snippet: Retrieval Model Relevant source files Purpose and Scope The BLIP Retrieval Model is a specialized component within the BLIP framework designed for cross-modal retrieval tasks. It enables bidirectional search between visual and textual data, specifically: Image-to-text retrieval: Finding relevant captions for a given image Text-to-image retrieval: Finding relevant images for a given text prompt ...

sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.
